title: 第22章 陆穿被抓啦
content_zh:
庆功宴的现场金碧辉煌，衣香鬓影间充满了推杯换盏的喧嚣。

    王忠磊满面红光，正举着酒杯站在宴会厅中央，接受着圈内同行和媒体们的轮番恭维。

    站在他身旁的陆穿虽然神色相对内敛，但眉梢眼角也掩饰不住这次票房大爆带来的意气风发。

    姜闻窝在一个角落里，看着王忠磊和陆穿那边，撇了撇嘴。

    “陆穿的新电影我看了好几遍，也没看明白，这电影凭什么有这么高票房。”姜闻说道。

    “就是因为你这样的人太多了，票房才这么高。”

    葛尤拿着一根鸡腿，乐呵呵的看着姜闻。

    电影本来只能算是水准之上，但看热闹的人多了，票房也就上去了。

    葛尤笑着说道：“现在大家的生活都比较富足。”

    “那踏马是人傻钱多。”姜闻骂道。

    陆穿那小子，之前被他骂的只敢躲在角落里面哭，现在因为捧着他的人太多了，抖起来了，都敢过来刺他几句了。

    姜闻压低了声音说道：“我感觉那天晚上对我下黑手的人是陆穿。”

    “不能吧？”葛尤看了一眼陆穿：“他看上去文质彬彬的，不像是干这事的人。”

    “哼！”

    姜闻冷哼一声：“那辆摩托车就停外面呢，我找人问了，那车就是陆穿的。”

    偏偏陆穿对他也是有偏见的，有动手的这个动机。

    “还是问清楚的好。”葛尤笑着说道。

    姜闻撇了撇嘴。

    他要是能承认就怪了。

    其实他之前没怎么怀疑陆穿这货，因为他胆小怕事，在剧组里连吵架都不敢，窝囊得很，怎么敢给他下黑手。

    姜闻压低脑袋问道：“你说，那个和陆穿一起的，有没有可能是那个叫谷川的？”

    “不好说。”

    王忠磊还在笑着和人聊天。

    “票房还没有过亿，但估计明天就能破亿了。”王忠磊笑着说道。

    短短时间内，先有《英雄》，后有《见鬼》，国产电影的形势一片大好啊。

    陆穿也和几个老总模样的人聊天，说着一些他们不懂的镜头语言，创作理念。

    “对了，听说电影的制片是美国回来的高材生？”有人问道。

    “没错。”王忠磊说道：“南加州大学导演系的，货真价实的高材生。”

    “怎么没看到他身影？”

    “他还在美国。”王忠磊说道：“好莱坞那边上映，是他负责的。”

    众人又是一阵恭维。

    能在美国上映，牛啊。

    就在王忠磊刚刚发表完一番“重塑行业标杆”的慷慨陈词，准备与陆穿碰杯庆祝这历史性时刻时，宴会厅那两扇大门突然被人从外面推开。
content_en:
The scene of the celebration banquet was resplendent, with fragrant clothes and shadows filled with the hustle and bustle of changing glasses.

    Wang Zhonglei's face was glowing, and he was standing in the center of the banquet hall holding a wine glass, accepting turns of compliments from his colleagues in the industry and the media.

    Although Lu Chuan, standing next to him, looked relatively reserved, his brows and eyes could not conceal the high spirits brought about by this box office hit.

    Jiang Wen nested in a corner, looking at Wang Zhonglei and Lu Chuan, and curled his lips.

    "I have watched Lu Chuan's new movie several times, but I still don't understand why this movie has such a high box office." Jiang Wen said.

    "It's because there are so many people like you that the box office is so high."

    Ge You held a chicken leg and looked at Jiang Wen happily.

    The movie was originally above average, but as more people watched it, the box office went up.

    Ge You said with a smile: "Everyone's life is relatively prosperous now."

    "That person is stupid and rich." Jiang Wen scolded.

    That kid Lu Chuan, who was scolded by him before, only dared to hide in a corner and cry, but now because there were so many people holding him, he started shaking, and even dared to come over and stab him a few times.

    Jiang Wen lowered his voice and said, "I feel that the person who did something dirty to me that night was Lu Chuan."

    "Can't you?" Ge You glanced at Lu Chuan: "He looks gentle and gentle, and he doesn't look like the person who did this."

    "Hmph!"

    Jiang Wen snorted coldly: "That motorcycle is parked outside. I asked someone and found out that the motorcycle belongs to Lu Chuan."

    But Lu Chuan was also biased against him and had the motive to do something.

    "It's better to ask clearly." Ge You said with a smile.

    Jiang Wen curled his lips.

    It would be weird if he admitted it.

    In fact, he didn't doubt Lu Chuan much before, because he was timid and afraid of getting into trouble. He didn't even dare to quarrel in the crew. He was so cowardly that he dared to do something against him.

    Jiang Wen lowered his head and asked, "Tell me, is it possible that the one with Lu Chuan is the one named Gu Chuan?"

    "It's hard to say."

    Wang Zhonglei was still smiling and chatting with others.

    "The box office has not yet exceeded 100 million, but it is estimated that it will exceed 100 million tomorrow." Wang Zhonglei said with a smile.

    In a short period of time, first there was "Hero" and then there was "Hell", and the situation for domestic films was great.

    Lu Chuan also chatted with a few people who looked like bosses, talking about camera language and creative ideas that they didn't understand.

    "By the way, I heard that the film's producer is a top student who came back from the United States?" someone asked.

    "That's right." Wang Zhonglei said, "He is a genuine top student from the directing department of the University of Southern California."

    "Why didn't you see him?"

    "He is still in the United States." Wang Zhonglei said: "He is responsible for the release in Hollywood."

    There was another burst of compliments from everyone.

    It's awesome that it can be released in the United States.

    Just when Wang Zhonglei had just delivered an impassioned speech about "reshaping the industry benchmark" and was about to clink glasses with Lu Chuan to celebrate this historic moment, the two doors of the banquet hall were suddenly pushed open from the outside.
